semantics: Return the start date of a record of the signal file loaded in player.

name: ChangeSignalDate
semantics: Change the start date of a signal in a measurement of a project. The signal must not be loaded in the player.

name: Download
semantics: Download signal file from OR3x to PC.

name: Upload
semantics: Upload signal file from PC to OR3x.

name: ImportFile
semantics: Import or convert signal or result file.

name: Export
semantics: Export results or signal in standard format.

name: AddResultToSetup
parameters: <Module number> <Process number> <Channel number> [Reference channel number] [Weighting operator] [Time operator] [Display unit] [IsWaterfall]
semantics: Adds a result to the save setup list

name: RemoveSetupResult
parameters: <Module number> <Process number> <Channel number> [Reference channel number] [Weighting operator] [Time operator] [Display unit] [IsWaterfall]
semantics: Removes a result from the save setup list

name: ClearSetupList
semantics: Clears the save setup result list

name: SetSetupParameters
semantics: Sets the parameters [Measurement database name] and [Increment type] of the save setup.

name: SetAutomaticExportSetup
semantics: Enable automatic export of the next saved results into the specified format <ExportType>. The exported files will be created in the specified directory.

name: SetNoAutomaticExport
semantics: Disable automatic export of results.

name: AddToResultSelection
semantics: Add the results of a window in the selection of the save setup.

name: RemoveToResultSelection
semantics: Remove the results of a window in the selection of the save setup.

name: SaveResults
semantics: Save the results that have been selected in the Save Setup in a new measurement

name: GetResultList
semantics: Allows the user to retrieve the list of available results. This list corresponds to the displayed signals and results.

name: GetWTFResultList
semantics: Allows the user to retrieve the list of available waterfall results. This list corresponds to the displayed signals and results.

name: GetResultCaption
semantics: Allows the user to retrieve the name of an available result, from the description of this result.

name: GetSavedResultList
semantics: Returns the list of result descriptions saved in a project measurement.

name: GetSavedResultCaption
parameters: <project name> <measurement name> <Module number> <Process number> <Channel number> [Reference channel number] [Waterfall / No Waterfall]
semantics: Allows the user to retrieve the name of a result saved in a project measurement.

name: CreateResultEx
parameters: <Module number> <Process number> <Channel number> [Reference channel number] [Waterfall Flag]
semantics: Prepare a result to be retrieved with the command GetResultEx.

name: GetResultEx
parameters: <Module number> <Process number> <Channel number> [Reference channel number] [Waterfall Flag]
semantics: Allows the user to retrieve a result, which has been created thanks to the CreateResultEx command.

name: GetSavedResultEx
parameters: <project name> <measurement name> <Module number> <Process number> <Channel number> [Reference channel number] [Waterfall Flag]
semantics: Allows the user to retrieve a result saved in a project measurement.

name: DeleteResultEx
parameters: <Module number> <Process number> <Channel number> [Reference channel number] [Waterfall Flag]
semantics: Delete a result created with the command CreateResultEx.

name: DeleteAllResultEx
semantics: Delete all the results created with the command CreateResultEx.

name: GetResult
parameters: <Module number> <Process number> <Channel number> [Reference channel number] [GetGlobalLevel Flag] [GetPondGlobalLevel Flag] [Version number]
semantics: Allows the user to retrieve a result, which is displayed in a window. Warning: Use the 3.7.25 - GetResultEx command instead of this command in the NVGate 3.10 and later.

name: GetWTFResult
parameters: <Module number> <Process number> <Channel number> [Reference channel number] [GetGlobalLevel Flag] [GetPondGlobalLevel Flag] [Version number] [Start Index] [Wanted Size]
semantics: Allows the user to retrieve a waterfall result, which is displayed in a window. Warning: Use the 3.7.25 - GetResultEx command instead of this command in the NVGate 3.10 and later.

name: GetSavedResult
parameters: <project name> <measurement name> <Module number> <Process number> <Channel number> [Reference channel number] [GetGlobalLevel flag] [GetPondGlobalLevel flag] [Version number]
semantics: Allows the user to retrieve a result saved in a project measurement. Attention: Use the 3.7.26 - GetSavedResultEx command instead of this command in the NVGate 3.10 and later.

name: CreateTCPResultChannel
semantics: Allows the user to create a TCP channel to send result into NVGate

name: RemoveTCPResultChannel
semantics: Allows the user to remove a TCP channel.

name: NewDataForTCPResultChannel
semantics: Allows the user to modify the data of a TCP channel to send result into NVGate. For SCAL block: Value (4 bytes) = Scalar value For XREF block: Data (Size*4 bytes) = Reference values For CVEC block: Data (Size*2*4 bytes) = Complex values (list of pairs) For RVEC block: Data (Size*4 bytes) = Real valu

name: AddDataToTCPResultChannel
semantics: Allows the user to add new data at the end of a TCP Result Channel (only for profile 2D type, for the other result types this command do the same as NewDataForTCPResultChannel command).

name: SetTCPResultChannel
semantics: Allows the user to modify the parameters (as name and others) and data of a TCP channel. This action includes the "NewDataForTCPResultChannel" action.

name: GetTCPResultChannelList
semantics: Returns the list of all the TCP result channel, with their description

name: GetTCPResult
semantics: Allows the user to retrieve a result, which has been created thanks to the CreateTCPResultChannel command

name: ChangeTCPResultName
semantics: Change result name of a TCP result.

name: CreateResultRecordSignal
semantics: Prepare the signal from the recorder to be retrieved as a signal result with the command GetResultRecordSignalBlock or GetResultRecordSignalZoom.

name: DeleteResultRecordSignal
semantics: Delete a signal result created with CreateResultRecordSignal.

name: DeleteAllResultRecordSignal
semantics: Delete all the signal results created with CreateResultRecordSignal.

name: GetResultRecordSignalBlock
semantics: Allows the user to retrieve a signal result, which has been created thanks to the CreateResultRecordSignal command.

name: GetResultRecordSignalZoom
semantics: Allows the user to retrieve a part of zoomed signal, which has been created thanks to the CreateResultRecordSignal command.

name: PrintReport
semantics: Prints a report.

name: ReportRefreshPrint
semantics: Trigger the Refresh and/or Print report command.

name: ReportGetInteractiveDocumentList
semantics: Search and return the list of documents that are selectable for an interactive report. After calling this command, the first document in the list is the current interactive report document.

name: ReportSelectInteractiveDocument
semantics: Select an interactive report document. Beware that you should call ReportGetInteractiveDocumentList before calling this command so that NVGate searches for currently open documents.

name: ConnectToTCPClient
category: TCP Client to Scan State, Setting, User Interface Notification, Command And Result
semantics: Creates a TCP socket connection between NVGate and the NVDrive® client application. This application must have a TCP server running on the specified port. The call of this command is necessary to use NVGate's notification system. Each NVDrive® client application should only send this command once.

name: DisconnectFromTCPClient
category: TCP Client to Scan State, Setting, User Interface Notification, Command And Result
semantics: Disconnect NVGate from the NVDrive® client application.

name: RegisterState
category: TCP Client to Scan State, Setting, User Interface Notification, Command And Result
semantics: Allows an NVDrive® client application to be notified when the specified state changed. The application must be connected with NVGate thru "ConnectToTCPClient" before using this function. Due to refreshing state period inside NVGate, some changes may not be received.

name: UnregisterState
category: TCP Client to Scan State, Setting, User Interface Notification, Command And Result
semantics: Unregister the specified state from the notification system.

name: RegisterSetting
category: TCP Client to Scan State, Setting, User Interface Notification, Command And Result
semantics: Allows an NVDrive® client application to be notified when the specified setting changed. The application must be connected with NVGate thru "ConnectToTCPClient" before using this function.

name: UnregisterSetting
category: TCP Client to Scan State, Setting, User Interface Notification, Command And Result
semantics: Unregister the specified setting from the notification system.

name: RegisterUINotification
category: TCP Client to Scan State, Setting, User Interface Notification, Command And Result
semantics: Allows an NVDrive® client application to be notified when the specified User Interface Notification changed. The application must be connected with NVGate thru "ConnectToTCPClient" before using this function.

name: ExecUINotification
category: TCP Client to Scan State, Setting, User Interface Notification, Command And Result
semantics: Allows an NVDrive® client application to execute a User Interface Notification if it has not been executed before (i.e., if the [Mode] parameter of the "RegisterUINotification" command is set to 1). The application must be connected with NVGate thru "ConnectToTCPClient" before using this function.

name: UnregisterUINotification
category: TCP Client to Scan State, Setting, User Interface Notification, Command And Result
semantics: Unregister the specified User Interface Notification from the notification system.

name: RegisterCommand
category: TCP Client to Scan State, Setting, User Interface Notification, Command And Result
semantics: Allows an NVDrive® client application to be notified when the specified command is sent. The application must be connected with NVGate thru "ConnectToTCPClient" before using this function.

name: UnregisterCommand
category: TCP Client to Scan State, Setting, User Interface Notification, Command And Result
semantics: Unregister the specified Command from the notification system.

name: RegisterNewResult
category: TCP Client to Scan State, Setting, User Interface Notification, Command And Result
semantics: Allows an NVDrive® client application to be notified when new results from the specified Module are available for transfer. New results are not computed for transfer until the command UnblockNewResult is sent (see next page). The application must be connected with NVGate thru "ConnectToTCPClient" be

name: UnblockNewResult
category: TCP Client to Scan State, Setting, User Interface Notification, Command And Result
semantics: Allows an NVDrive® client application unblocks new results transfer from the specified Module. The application must be connected with NVGate thru "ConnectToTCPClient" before using this function.

name: UnregisterNewResult
category: TCP Client to Scan State, Setting, User Interface Notification, Command And Result
semantics: Unregister the new results computed from the specified Module from the notification system.

name: RegisterNewMeasurement
category: TCP Client to Scan State, Setting, User Interface Notification, Command And Result
semantics: Allows an NVDrive® client application to be notified when a new measurement is created in the current project. The application must be connected with NVGate thru "ConnectToTCPClient" before using this function.

name: UnregisterNewMeasurement
category: TCP Client to Scan State, Setting, User Interface Notification, Command And Result
semantics: Unregister the "new measurement" event from the notification system.

name: AddCurrentSetup
semantics: Used to generate and upload a configuration on the analyzer. Only Front-end, Recorder, and Event are present in this configuration.

name: RemoveRecorderSetup
semantics: Remove a configuration on the analyzer.

name: GetRecorderSetupList
semantics: Get the list of recorder setup names that are present on the analyzer.

name: GetDefaultRecorderSetup
semantics: Get the name of the configuration present on the analyzer that will be loaded by default.

name: SetDefaultRecorderSetup
semantics: Affects the name of the default recorder configuration on the analyzer.

name: ExportRecorderConfigAsText
semantics: Export a recorder configuration in a text file.

semantics: Import a recorder configuration in the Analyzer setting browser of NVGate. Returns the currently selected EV/HV measurement selected as current measurement for Spatiogram calculation.
